quest.title: Well Done! What's the Next Big Plan?
quest.description: With your help, the lens testing is finally complete. But now that Lepine-Pauline has suddenly shown up, it looks like she's already planning another big business venture...

choices.text: Took quite a few photos this time.

response.speaker: Ninette
response.text: That's wonderful! Thank you so much for your help!

response.speaker: Ninette
response.text: While you were busy taking those photos, I started thinking I can't just stand by and do nothing, or I'll never make any progress...

response.speaker: Ninette
response.text: So I worked up the courage to ask a few passersby for help, and I even managed to take quite a few shots myself! I think that should be plenty of data for testing.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: #Heh, I knew you wouldn't let me down! Thanks to {NICKNAME} for stepping in as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lepine-Pauline! When did you get back? Ninette said you've been busy with something else lately.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Well obviously, it's a massive deal — enough to fill my pockets to the brim!

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Things got pretty busy for me lately, so I'm really glad you were there to help Ninette out.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: She's got the talent and the taste, that's for sure. She's just a bit shy. But with your help, she's really taken an important step forward.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, what's this "massive deal" you've been so mysterious about? Don't tell Paimon you heard another wild rumor and went all in again!

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: What? Of course not! I've learned my lesson. This time it's the real deal — safe and sure to make a fortune!

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Hmph, if I tell you now, it'll ruin the surprise. Once it's done, you'll be the first to try it out!
